quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials 2025 capacity build-out: construction in progress rose to RMB 136,218,256.00 from RMB 40,414,095.88 (up 237.06%), mainly nickel powder production lines and plant construction; year-end projects include 30 sets of powder-making equipment RMB 34,464,525.55, grading production equipment RMB 32,369,959.11, No. 3 workshop and auxiliary buildings RMB 20,494,565.56 and a silicon powder project RMB 40,128,630.16 (all self-funded). In 2025 nickel powder powder-making equipment (30 sets) RMB 45,783,209.75 and phase-1 powder-making equipment (27 sets) RMB 36,864,799.06 were added and transferred to fixed assets. The company says it is expanding nickel-based capacity in phases matched to market demand and order intake; investing cash outflow was RMB 320,663,498.59 net, mainly civil works and production equipment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials 2025 R&D and products: R&D spend RMB 47,993,988.70 (down 4.36%), 4.17% of revenue, none capitalised; 119 R&D staff (10.85% of employees); 181 valid patents (64 domestic invention patents, 37 overseas). In 2025 it developed several new nickel-based product specifications that completed evaluation and volume ramp at multiple domestic and overseas customers; a specific-spec nickel product for automotive capacitors passed customer validation; the share of lower-silver silver-coated copper powder in shipments kept rising; base-metal substitution products for PV makers reached small-batch shipments.

quarterly_data.quarter: Boqian New Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Boqian New Materials 2026 business plan (company outlook): it targets growth in both scale and profit. In nickel it will work on dispersion of small-particle nickel powder and raise the utilisation of small-particle nickel semi-finished product, which it says will also ease the capacity shortfall in other particle-size products; it will speed volume production of validated new products. In alloy powders it will deepen cooperation with leading domestic companies. In photovoltaics the company says 2026 will be a key point for large-scale market use of copper-based products and silver-coated base-metal powders.
